 ‘He’s a special player’: Valencia boss praises Sadiq ahead of Real Madrid showdown
 The experienced Mexican tactician was full of praise for Sadiq during Friday's pre-match press conference, highlighting the forward's character, footballing intelligence and qualities both on and off the pitch
 by Gbemidepo Popoola 
 November 7, 2026 
 Reading Time: 2 mins read
 0 
 Add us on Google 
 Valencia manager Javier Aguirre has expressed his admiration for Super Eagles striker Umar Sadiq, describing the Nigerian international as a special player with an outstanding personality ahead of Saturday’s La Liga showdown against Real Madrid at the Mestalla.
 Join the Premium Times WhatsApp Community For Quick Access To News and Happenings Around You.
 Open in WhatsApp 
 The experienced Mexican tactician heaped praise on Sadiq during Friday’s pre-match press conference, highlighting the forward’s character, footballing intelligence, and qualities both on and off the pitch.
 Sadiq has made an encouraging return to action after spending approximately two months on the sidelines with a hamstring injury, announcing his comeback spectacularly with the decisive goal in Valencia’s 1-0 victory over Elche in their previous league outing.
 Coming off the bench to make his first appearance under Aguirre, the Nigerian forward needed little time to make his presence felt, finding the breakthrough to secure all three points for Los Che and hand their new manager his first victory since taking charge of the club.
 The goal was particularly important for Sadiq, who had endured a frustrating spell away from competitive football following his injury setback. His return not only gave Valencia a timely attacking boost but also reminded everyone why the club pursued him.
 With his fitness improving and his confidence seemingly restored, the 29-year-old is now pushing for a starting role when Valencia welcome Real Madrid on Saturday evening.
 Aguirre, who appears increasingly impressed by the Nigerian’s qualities, did not attempt to hide his admiration for the striker, describing him as an individual whose personality and footballing ability make him a valuable squad member.

 “He’s a character. He’s a good guy with a kind heart. He’s a special player,” Aguirre told reporters.
 “He shows details fitting of a great player. I’m very happy with him; let’s see if he can bring us more moments of joy like the one the other day.”
 The manager’s comments represent a significant vote of confidence for Sadiq as he looks to establish himself under the new technical leadership at the Mestalla.
 Beyond his match-winning contribution against Elche, the Nigerian offers Valencia a different attacking dimension through his physical presence, movement, ability to occupy defenders and capacity to create opportunities in the final third.
 His availability will be particularly important against a Real Madrid side whose defensive organisation and individual quality are expected to provide a stern examination for Valencia.
 READ ALSO:  Injury Update: Super Eagles striker Umar Sadiq nears Valencia return 
 Saturday’s encounter also gives Sadiq a chance to reach a personal milestone.
 The Super Eagles forward will be targeting goals in three consecutive La Liga appearances, a feat he has managed only once in his career, during the 2022/23 season.
 Having already made a decisive impact on his return from injury, Sadiq will be eager to carry that momentum into one of Valencia’s biggest fixtures of the campaign.
 For Aguirre, another influential performance from the Nigerian would provide further encouragement as he continues to rebuild Valencia’s fortunes.
 With the Mestalla expected to provide an intense atmosphere for the visit of Real Madrid, Sadiq has an opportunity to turn his impressive comeback into another memorable performance and strengthen his case for a regular starting position under the Mexican manager.
